notablePrerequisites: Estrid's Invocation on the battlefield as a copy of Myth Unbound.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tamiyo, adding {U}.
Choose to return Tamiyo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Estrid's Invocation trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Tamiyo from the command zone by paying {U}.
Repeat.
